Let’s evaluate step by step.  

Expression:  
\[
( ( \text{not False} ) \ \text{and} \ \text{False} )
\]

1. Evaluate innermost parentheses first:  
\[
\text{not False} = \text{True}
\]

2. Substitute back:  
\[
( \text{True} \ \text{and} \ \text{False} )
\]

3. Apply AND:  
\[
\text{True and False} = \text{False}
\]

Final answer: false
